data.title: A succession battle erupts over a late Ugandan monarch
data.description: NEW YORK — A television anchor. A young, mysterious heir. An amateur football player nicknamed “Big G.” Those were the people offered as candidates for the throne of the Tooro Kingdom in Uganda, after its former boy king died of cancer at age 34 last month.

data.title: Kim Jong Un wants North Koreans to have more (state-sanctioned) fun
data.description: Recent developments in North Korea include shopping malls, beach ​resorts, waterparks

data.title: The Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted in national security trial
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court sentenced three pro-democracy activists on Friday who organised annual vigils to mark China's deadly Tiananmen crackdown on charges of "incitement to subversion".

data.title: Appreciation, anger await as Trump heads to Irish golf resort
data.description: DOONBEG — In the windswept village of Doonbeg on Ireland's Atlantic coast, Donald Trump is less polarising United States president and more golf resort owner credited with bringing jobs and money to a remote corner of the country.

data.title: Party leaders trade barbs before Swedish election
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden's party leaders traded barbs on housing, schools, jobs and the climate in one of their final televised debates ahead of Sunday's general election, which could see a left-wing government come to power.

data.title: Manchester derby poses Maresca's first big test, Chelsea aim to end Hull Honeymoon
data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: Statecraft or scripture: Why Pacific nations want Jerusalem embassies
data.description: SYDNEY — An ancient Biblical prophecy lies at the heart of a Pacific islands push to open embassies on contested ground in Jerusalem, experts and former diplomats told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: China, Iran among countries that have used AI to aid spying, Anthropic says
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO - Anthropic said on Thursday it shut down multiple cases of state-sponsored surveillance operations that used its artificial intelligence (AI) models, and warned that governments and state-aligned actors are increasingly using AI to spy on ethnic minorities and dissidents.

data.title: Hong Kong sentences Tiananmen activists to between 5 and 7 years in jail
data.description: HONG KONG — A Hong Kong court handed three Tiananmen vigil activists jail sentences of between five and seven years on Friday for national security crimes, following a trial that has drawn international condemnation.

data.title: Musk threatens legal action over documentary
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's lawyers put the makers of a new four-hour documentary about the multibillionaire on formal legal notice days before its premiere, warning that the film defames him.

data.title: Tremor recorded as Israel says Hezbollah tunnels destroyed in south Lebanon
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Thursday it demolished key tunnels built by the Iran-backed Hezbollah group beneath the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor.

data.title: Carney says in touch with Trump, Canada ready for 'fair' trade deal
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Prime Minister Mark Carney said Thursday that he had spoken to US President Donald Trump "in recent days" and Ottawa remains ready to reach a "fair" trade deal with Washington, despite escalating economic tensions.

data.title: Canada pledges support for Ukraine air defense as Zelensky visits
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Canada offered support Thursday to boost Ukraine's air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by President Volodymyr Zelensky.

data.title: Morocco says not involved in Ceuta migrant influx
data.description: RABAT - Morocco said on Thursday there were "no facts" establishing its involvement in the massive migrant rush into Spain's North African exclave of Ceuta in July.

data.title: Latin America could see fresh disinformation after Meta changes
data.description: MONTEVIDEO - As Meta moves to scrap fact-checking for Facebook and Instagram posts across Latin America, experts predict the change will lead to sharply degraded public debate in the region.

data.title: Russian strike on Ukraine shopping centre kills at least six
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - At least five people were killed and nearly 70 others wounded on Thursday when a Russian strike hit a shopping centre in Pavlograd, central Ukraine, the authorities announced.

data.title: NGO chief sees 'hypocrisy' in Afghan women's rights calls amid aid cuts
data.description: KABUL - The head of the Norwegian Refugee Council aid group, Jan Egeland, criticised on Thursday what he called the "hypocrisy" of countries demanding rights for Afghan women while cutting humanitarian assistance.

data.title: In their words: Israeli forces describe AI-backed Gaza killing in new film
data.description: VENICE - A new documentary from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers provides damning new testimony about AI-enabled mass killings in Gaza from the men and women who took part, the directors told AFP on Thursday ahead of its premiere in Venice.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis seize key city on Red Sea: military source
data.description: SANAA - Yemen's Houthis seized control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha on Thursday, a Yemeni military source told AFP, as the Iran-backed group reported fresh strikes by Saudi forces.

data.title: Analysts say Israel's right could exploit sanctions in run-up to vote
data.description: JERUSALEM - British-led sanctions over settlement expansion in the West Bank may have the unintended effect of emboldening the Israeli right ahead of elections, analysts and a diplomatic source told AFP.

data.title: Vance takes spotlight as Republicans close Trump-heavy convention
data.description: DALLAS (UNITED STATES) - US Republicans returned to the stage Thursday to close their midterm convention, still betting that Donald Trump's political magnetism can overcome grim election forecasts -- while giving Vice President JD Vance a prime-time showcase as a potential heir.

data.title: Trump promises Americans $5,000 if Republicans win Congress
data.description: DALLAS — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday promised US$5,000 to every American adult if Republicans retain control of Congress in November, coupling the extraordinary claim with a plea for his supporters to "pretend" he was on the ballot.

data.title: Macron urges Europe to develop 'crewed spaceflight' programme
data.description: PARIS — French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday called on Europe to develop its own crewed spaceflight capability within a decade as part of a broader push to strengthen the continent's space sector.

data.title: North Korea leader's daughter believed to have younger sibling: Seoul
data.description: SEOUL - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter and apparent successor is believed to have a younger sibling, South Korea's spy agency said on Thursday, offering a more detailed view of the ruling family's line of succession.

data.title: Wars pose a test as India hosts Brics summit
data.description: NEW DELHI - India will host leaders including the presidents of Russia and Iran for a Brics summit on Saturday, with wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, as well as economic challenges, to dominate talks among the 11-member group.

data.title: Sri Lankan monk sent back to jail as pardon revoked
data.description: COLOMBO - Sri Lanka’s Supreme Court overturned Thursday a presidential pardon granted to a hardline nationalist Buddhist monk and ordered him to serve the remainder of a six-year prison sentence for intimidating the wife of a missing cartoonist.

data.title: Mount Fuji hiking season ends with landslide, rescues
data.description: TOKYO - A landslide struck a car park on Mount Fuji, with the final day of the volcano’s summer climbing season on Thursday marred by downpours and dense mist.

data.title: Philippine ferry fire kills at least five, dozens missing
data.description: MANILA - At least five people were killed and 86 remain missing after a fire erupted aboard a ferry near a tourist hotspot in the Philippine province of Palawan, the coast guard said Thursday.

data.title: Evacuations in Malibu as sinkhole opens at Nicolas Cage’s house
data.description: LOS ANGELES - People living in an upmarket coastal stretch of Malibu were under an evacuation order on Wednesday after a giant sinkhole opened up on the driveway of a beachfront home belonging to Oscar-winning US actor Nicolas Cage.

data.title: Myanmar tin mega-mine restarts operations
data.description: YANGON - One of the world’s biggest tin mines, located in an autonomous region of war-torn Myanmar, is resuming operations suspended since 2023 and ramping up exports to China, a think tank said on Thursday.

data.title: Defiant Trump promises ‘surge’ in November polls
data.description: DALLAS - A defiant Donald Trump has vowed Republicans would “surge forward” in November’s midterm elections, seeking to rally his party against grim poll forecasts, weak approval ratings and mounting voter discontent over prices and his war with Iran.

data.title: August ‘hottest month ever recorded globally’
data.description: PARIS - August was the hottest single month ever recorded globally, with ocean temperatures also reaching unprecedented highs as western Europe capped its warmest summer, the EU’s climate monitor said on Thursday.

data.title: How hot can the US-Canada trade war get?
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - The US-Canada trade war has escalated rapidly, rupturing what was once one of the world's closest economic partnerships.
